data.name: Borough Of Blood
data.detailed_description:
[Still in Development]

Borough of Blood is a post-apocalyptic survival game set in the British town of Northampton. Players must explore, scavenge, and fight to survive in a world overrun by the undead.

The game combines story-driven missions with open-ended exploration, allowing players to follow the main quest or freely roam the environment in search of supplies and hidden lore.

Gameplay Overview:

  • Survival Mechanics: Manage limited resources such as food, ammunition, and medical supplies while avoiding or confronting the infected.

  • Combat System: Engage in first-person or third-person combat using a range of melee weapons and firearms.

  • Exploration: Traverse detailed environments including streets, homes, shops, and rural outskirts of Northampton.

  • Scavenging and Crafting: Collect materials from the environment to craft tools, weapons, and survival items.

  • Story and Missions: Uncover the events behind the outbreak through main quests, side activities, and environmental storytelling.

Key Features:

  • Open-world inspired level design focused on realism and immersion

  • Grounded survival gameplay with crafting and looting systems

  • Story-driven main quest with optional exploration and discovery

  • Detailed representation of a modern British town in an apocalyptic setting

  • Atmospheric audio design and original soundtrack

data.short_description: [Still in Development] A post-apocalyptic zombie survival game set in the UK. Explore an open world, scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and uncover the story behind the fall of Northampton.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100, AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650, AMD Radeon RX 5500XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains violence, blood, and gore consistent with a zombie survival setting. Players will encounter depictions of combat involving melee and ranged weapons, including graphic injury effects. The game features dark and distressing themes related to survival, death, and the collapse of society.

There are no depictions of sexual content, sexual assault, self-harm, or drug use in this title.
